duplicate_root_cause.explanation: REQUESTS/RESPONSES append an earlier partial cube_clean session (~3.7h before the final run). The final run seeded by_key from those responses and re-executed shared prompts under new keys; vLLM temp-0 outputs can diverge across server restarts. Resolution is deterministic (first occurrence in ledger order) and identical in the runner and the independent analyzer (15/15 agreement), so the cube measurement stays well-defined; provenance is two server sessions, documented here.
